name: SP11 Audio GOLDEN v33 — TOP_CFG1 physical VI parity

snd_q6apm.role: unchanged Golden mapping; no SP_VI reorder

proven_delta: On microsoft,denali physically write WSA TOP_CFG1=0x03 after each enabled VI pair, matching native Windows and correcting pre-SPVI TAP2 from I,V,I,V to V,I,V,I.

objective_gates.first_frame: Windows and v33 TAP2 are V,I,V,I from the first valid packet; v32 was I,V,I,V. No sentinel/garbage startup block.
objective_gates.quiet_zero: Dedicated literal-zero starts stay near the SP7 RAW room floor (~-97 dBFS in 3–20 kHz).
objective_gates.windows_linux_10pct: fresh source-identical quiet-room A/B within about ±0.1 dB across useful bands.
objective_gates.windows_linux_50pct: 10 s interior: broadband +0.027 dB; 80 Hz–10 kHz +0.002 dB; 200 Hz–5 kHz -0.011 dB; 315 Hz–8 kHz -0.022 dB; 3–10 kHz -0.016 dB; 40–120 Hz +0.089 dB; envelope correlation 0.956.
objective_gates.cold_soak: 20/20 true-cold 50% cycles alternating 160/997 Hz at 0.20 source peak; 20 enables/20 disables; zero PA faults, zero err0=0x20, zero XRUN/underrun/overrun.
objective_gates.one_off_note: A stricter 50 ms post-analysis found one isolated broadband burst on soak cycle 1. It had no kernel fault and did not recur in cycles 2–20 or a dedicated long-idle two-birth literal-zero reproduction; retained as non-reproducible evidence.

hardening.policy: The root module tree is synchronized to v33 so future initramfs generation cannot silently restore v32. Golden v32 fixed boot assets remain untouched rollback.
